artifacts.summary: Verdict-first design: KEEP specs/CHANGE_LOG.md unmodified (re-verified not stale, self-healing batch writer), accept-and-work-around the task {N}: commit convention (session_id already provides the durable join), no new field/file/script, and a documentation-only cross-record decision-citation convention (project_name slug + artifact round + Decision N) as the one genuine gap.

memory_candidates.content: In this agent-system, .orchestrator-handoff.json's decisions_made field is EPHEMERAL (overwritten every dispatch cycle per handoff-schema.md's Writing Contract) and must not be confused with the durable, append-only .decisions.json (which records only AskUserQuestion-surfaced user_decision answers, written by orchestrate-record-decision.sh). Neither is a general durable design-decision log; the actual durable home for design decisions is the mandatory ## Decisions heading inside report/summary artifacts.

scripts/dispatch-metrics.sh correlates git commits with a dispatch via `git log --grep="<session_id>"`, never by parsing the `task {N}: {action}` subject-line convention. The task number baked into commit subjects is human-skimming sugar only; the one real machine join key is the opaque, renumbering-immune session_id trailer (present in ~96% of commits sampled). Relevant to any future question about historical commit-message ambiguity after a vault renumbering.

specs/CHANGE_LOG.md's writer (skill-todo's UpdateChangelog stage) is self-healing under a long gap between /todo runs: a ~5-week gap observed 2026-09-29 to 2026-11-04 was caught up in one batched commit (222 lines, 44 tasks) with no data loss. A measured staleness window in this file does not by itself imply lost data -- re-check the next /todo run's diff before concluding anything was dropped.

next_steps: Run /orchestrate 459 to create implementation plan (scope: three documentation edits under agent-system/extensions/core/context/formats/{report,summary,plan}-format.md per the report's Decision 5 -- no new field, file, or script).
